summary: Frontend-only retest of iteration_127 fixes for the per-device PIN login flow. All 4 requested scenarios pass. (1) Mobile 390: fresh storage, MobileEmailLogin demo -> mandatory personal-pin-setup-modal on solid orange (rgb 255,92,0) background, no skip and no 'Later instellen'; enter+confirm 2468 -> /kiosk with Beheer menu; device_user_name stored as 'Demo Beheerder'. (2) Desktop 1920: demo email login -> no popup -> /kiosk; Uitloggen -> /my-awesome-rentals-bv/login?pick=1&loggedout=1 shows PIN screen 'Welkom terug, Demo Beheerder'; wrong PIN 1111 -> pin-error 'Ongeldige PIN code'; 2468 -> /kiosk admin mode (kiosk-admin-menu-btn present). (3) Superadmin email login: popup never shown (polled 7s) -> /admin SaaS Overzicht. (4) Ander account clears device_user_email and shows email form; boekhouder -> no popup -> /kiosk with Beheer menu; kiosk.medewerker -> /my-awesome-rentals-bv/login?target=kiosk&view=pin -> PIN 5566 -> /my-awesome-rentals-bv/kiosk without Beheer menu.

Desktop: logout -> PIN screen with full name 'Welkom terug, Demo Beheerder'
Desktop: wrong PIN -> pin-error; correct PIN 2468 -> /kiosk admin mode
Superadmin: no PIN popup, lands on /admin

Boekhouder (PIN 6677 set) -> no popup -> /kiosk with Beheer menu
Kiosk medewerker + PIN 5566 -> kiosk without Beheer menu
critical_code_review_comments: afterPasswordLogin treats a failed /auth/personal-pin/status call as hasPin=true, so a network error silently skips the mandatory PIN step (fail-open). Consider failing closed or retrying.
PIN pad has no physical-keyboard support on desktop (typing digits does nothing); only on-screen keypad clicks work. Minor UX gap for desktop users.
